description: Provides additional portraits for the Valkyrians faction. These portraits are intended to offer more variety for players using that faction. The author has not yet contacted the original mod author for permission.

gallery.aiCaption: A grid of eight character portraits showing pairs of male and female faces with edited features.
Three side-by-side comparisons of atmospheric illustrations featuring silhouettes against planets and burning landscapes.
A collection of eight stylized character portraits including women with animal ears and men in military or formal attire.
A grid of nine female portrait thumbnails labeled with filenames such as Valk_M_21.png through Valk_M_47.png.
